title: The Forwarding Address
description: Darnell filed a change of address so his mail follows him. It worked too well. A postal clerk named Wendell calmly explains that the new address is not an apartment, it's Regional Sorting, and the only way to stop being forwarded is to file as undeliverable.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM. Our next caller just moved into a new place and says the post office is being a little too helpful. Darnell, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Hey, Ronnie. Yeah, so, I filed a change of address last week. Routine thing. Mail follows me to the new apartment.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Sounds like it's working great.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: It's working too great, Barry. First the mail forwarded. Fine. Then my magazine subscriptions forwarded. Then my dentist appointment forwarded.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that is a thorough postal service.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Then this morning I went to remember my mom's birthday. <p:0.3> And it was gone, Ronnie. The memory. There was a little slip where it used to be. It said, forwarded.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Okay, that's not the post office, that's just getting older.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: It had a tracking number on it, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Just throw the slip away. Just shred it.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: I shredded it. <p:0.3> The shredder forwarded it. There's a clerk on the line, he wants to confirm the new address.

lines.speaker: clerk-wendell
lines.text: Good evening. <p:0.3> I have a recipient here updating delivery. Per postal regulation, I just need to confirm the forwarding address on file.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Go right ahead, sir. What's the new address?

lines.speaker: clerk-wendell
lines.text: It's not an apartment, recipient. <p:0.3> The address on file is Regional Sorting. Everything routes through there now. The recipient included.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The recipient included? Darnell, just cancel the forward. Just call them and cancel it.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: I tried, Barry. I filed a cancellation. <p:0.3> Then the cancellation got forwarded. So I filed a cancellation of that one. It says... in transit.

lines.speaker: clerk-wendell
lines.text: That's correct, recipient. Each cancellation generates a forward of the cancellation. Per postal regulation, we cannot stop a parcel that is already moving.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Ronnie! Ronnie, it's Mildred, I live next door to Darnell. I'm looking out my window right now. His mailbox is gone.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Gone how? Like somebody took it?

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Gone like it was never there, Barry. <p:0.3> Now the porch is gone. Now his welcome mat. <p:0.3> Now the porch light's just hanging in the air.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Wendell, what does it take to stop being forwarded? There has to be a form.

lines.speaker: clerk-wendell
lines.text: There is one option, recipient. <p:0.4> You file as undeliverable. That ends the forwarding immediately.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well there you go, Darnell, file the undeliverable. Problem solved.

lines.speaker: clerk-wendell
lines.text: I should clarify, recipient. <p:0.3> Undeliverable means you cease to exist as a valid recipient. There is no address. There is no one to deliver to.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Do not file that, Darnell. Do NOT file the undeliverable.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Now his front door's gone, Ronnie! It's just a wall! <p:0.3> Now the wall is gone!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Status changed. <p:0.3> It says out for delivery.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Out for delivery to WHERE, Darnell?

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: He's getting blurry, Barry! Like the edges!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Delivery attempted. <p:0.3> Recipient not found.

lines.speaker: clerk-wendell
lines.text: Standard, recipient. We'll attempt again.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Hang up the phone! Just hang up!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Status updated. <p:0.3> Recipient redefined.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Darnell? <p:0.3> Where's Darnell?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Darnell, buddy, you still with us? Read me that status one more time.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: It says... <p:0.4> delivered.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Delivered. <p:0.3> Ronnie, he said delivered, and he said it like Wendell.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well, he made it to the new address. <p:0.3> Now that's a smooth delivery.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Oh, line two's lighting up. Snazzie FM, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Per postal regulation, you have mail.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now THAT'S service.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie. <p:0.3> Ronnie, do NOT sign for it.

lines.speaker: clerk-wendell
lines.text: Accepted.
